14. They are ignored. They must never cause an error. A warning is fine.
15. Yes. Header names are matched case-insensitively and surrounding spaces are ignored.

22. Yes. On any `ImportFileError`, the repo is left completely untouched.
23. Yes, partial import. Good rows go in, and bad rows go into `errors` and are skipped. A bad row isn't applied at all, not even partly to an existing contact.
